t: Define the dogfood skill — sub-agent validation protocol for lugs, ideas, and modifications before they ship
perceive: 1. Read templates/commands/wai-improve.md Step 6c (existing dogfood check) — this is the inline version that the skill should formalize. 2. Read .claude/agents/lug-reviewer.md — existing sub-agent that validates lugs. 3. Read templates/commands/wai-lug-schema.md — PEV field requirements that dogfooding validates.
execute: 1. Create templates/commands/wai-dogfood.md skill file. Core protocol: (a) accept input: lug JSON, idea brief, or modification spec. (b) spawn a fresh sub-agent (general-purpose, no framework context loaded — only the input). (c) sub-agent attempts to understand and act on the input cold. (d) sub-agent reports: what it understood, what was unclear, what it would do, what's missing. (e) compare sub-agent interpretation against intended meaning. (f) output structured assessment: {understood: bool, gaps: [], misinterpretations: [], verdict: PASS|NEEDS_WORK|FAIL}. 2. Create templates/spoke/skills/dogfood/wai-dogfood.md (copy). 3. Register in WAI-Skills.jsonl: id=dogfood, type=guard, advisory=true, watchers=['lug.*created', 'idea.*proposed']. 4. Update wai-improve.md Step 6c to reference /wai-dogfood as the formal skill instead of inline instructions. 5. Sync to WAI-Spoke/commands/ and WAI-Spoke/skills/dogfood/.
verify: 1. Skill file exists at templates/commands/wai-dogfood.md. 2. Registered in WAI-Skills.jsonl. 3. Running /wai-dogfood on a well-formed lug returns PASS. 4. Running on a lug with vague PEV returns NEEDS_WORK with specific gaps. 5. wai-improve.md Step 6c references /wai-dogfood.
acceptance_criteria: templates/commands/wai-dogfood.md skill file exists with cold-reader validation protocol
Skill registered in WAI-Skills.jsonl with type=guard, advisory=true
wai-improve.md Step 6c references /wai-dogfood instead of inline instructions
Running /wai-dogfood on well-formed lug returns PASS
Running /wai-dogfood on vague lug returns NEEDS_WORK with specific gaps listed

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Define the dogfood skill as a standalone WAI skill — formalize the inline dogfood check from wai-improve into a reusable skill
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: Not changing what dogfooding tests — same cold-reader validation, just extracted into a proper skill file
